result.topic_en: Euler concludes that no number of the form ff+fg+gg or pp+3qq is divisible by a prime of the form 3n−1, deduces that −3 is a quadratic residue of primes 3n+1 and a non-residue of primes 3n−1, and begins a scholium classifying primes by their form mod 12 to decide whether +3 and −3 are residues.
result.transcription:
PER NVMEROS PRIMOS. 123
bent reſidua, neque ergo binorum differentia, vel
numerus huius formae $ff+fg+gg$ exhiberi poteſt,
qui per $3n-1$ diuidi poſſet; quod proinde etiam
de numeris huius formae $pp+3qq$ locum habet.
Atque hoc adeo de omnibus numeris formae $3n-1$
valet, quoniam ſi non fuerint primi, factorem
ſaltem primum iſtius formae inuoluunt.
Coroll. 1.
77. Si igitur forma $pp+3qq$ per nume-
rum primum $3n+1$ ſit diuiſibilis, et quadratum
$qq$ per eundem diuiſum relinquat reſiduum $\gamma$, al-
terum quadratum $pp$ relinquet reſiduum $-3\gamma$. Vn-
de ſi omnes numeri quadrati per numerum primum
$3n+1$ diuidantur, in reſiduis certe reperitur $-3$
vel $3n-2$.
Coroll. 2.
78. Sin autem omnes numeri quadrati per nu-
merum primum formae $3n-1$ diuidantur, in ſe-
rie reſiduorum certe non erit numerus $-3$; ideoque
$-3$ vel $3n-4$ erit non-reſiduum.
Scholion.
79. Hinc ſi numeri quadrati per numerum
quemcunque primum diuidantur, de binis numeris
$+3$ et $-3$ iudicari poterit, vtrum in ordine reſi-
duorum an non-reſiduorum occurrant. Omnes enim
numeri primi praeter 2 et 3 qui hic non ſpectantur
in aliqua harum quatuor formarum continentur:
$12m+1 \quad 12m+5; \quad 12m+7; \quad 12m+11$

items.quote:
neque ergo binorum differentia, vel
numerus huius formae $ff+fg+gg$ exhiberi poteſt,
qui per $3n-1$ diuidi poſſet; quod proinde etiam
de numeris huius formae $pp+3qq$ locum habet.
items.english: Therefore neither the difference of two of them, nor a number of the form ff+fg+gg, can be exhibited which could be divided by 3n−1; which consequently also holds for numbers of the form pp+3qq.

items.quote:
Vn-
de ſi omnes numeri quadrati per numerum primum
$3n+1$ diuidantur, in reſiduis certe reperitur $-3$
vel $3n-2$.
items.english: Hence if all square numbers are divided by a prime 3n+1, −3, i.e. 3n−2, is certainly found among the residues.

items.quote:
in ſe-
rie reſiduorum certe non erit numerus $-3$; ideoque
$-3$ vel $3n-4$ erit non-reſiduum.
items.english: In the series of residues there will certainly not be the number −3; hence −3, i.e. 3n−4, will be a non-residue.

items.quote:
de binis numeris
$+3$ et $-3$ iudicari poterit, vtrum in ordine reſi-
duorum an non-reſiduorum occurrant.
items.english: It can be decided about the two numbers +3 and −3 whether they occur among the residues or among the non-residues.
